Inis Cealtra Pastoral Area News The Inis Cealtra Pastoral Area comprises of the parishes of Bodyke & Tuamgraney, Ogonnelloe, Scariff, Feakle, Killanena & Flagmount, Mountshannon (Clonrush) & Whitegate and also provides services to Raheen Community Hospital. Family Carers Ireland Support Group Are you a family carer and looking for some support? Join us on the fourth Tuesday of each month at Bodyke GAA Community Hall V94 YH32 from 11am to 1pm. This non-judgement group offers discussion, support and an opportunity to make friends. Also learn more about the free services and supports we offer you, the family carer. Next meeting will be on Tuesday November 24th . The greatest evil in the world Mother Teresa said: ‘Many today are starving for ordinary bread. But there is another kind of hunger - the hunger to be wanted, to be loved, to be recognised. Nakedness too is not just the want of clothes, but also about loss of dignity, purity, and self-respect. And homelessness is not just want of a house; there is the homelessness of being rejected, of being unwanted in a throwaway society. The biggest disease in the world today is the feeling of being unwanted and uncared for. The greatest evil in the world is lack of love, the terrible indifference towards one’s neighbour. ’ Lord, warm our cold hearts with your grace, so that we your disciples may produce the fruits of love. Bodyke/Tuamgraney Parish Ministers of Word / Readers & EUCHARISTIC Ministers: We extend a warm welcome to all who are part of the Ministry of the Word & Eucharistic Ministers to an evening of appreciation, reflection & little input in the Bodyke GAA Community Hall, Tuamgraney V94 YH32 on Wednesday 25th November at 7.30 pm. We will join on the night with members from Ogonnelloe Parish. We would like to invite Parents of children who are eligible to become Altar Servers to discuss it at home. Children who are in 3rd Class or higher in school would be eligible. Please consider it and if child is willing Parents can let Kieran know and he will provide training. Christmas Fair: Raheen Community Nursing Unit & Day Care Centre will hold its 2026 Christmas Fair on Saturday, 28th November at 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. Any donations can be dropped to the Day Centre before Friday, 27th November or phone

to arrange drop off. Thank you. The Pastoral Council sincerely thank the volunteers who helped to do a'big clean up' of Kilnoe graveyard and St. Cronan's graveyard in recent weeks. To complete the task, we now ask families to attend to their loved ones graves. We remind people outside the parish and around the Pastoral area to take care of any graves they have in St. Cronan's graveyard also. Spread a little kindness this Christmas As part of our Jingle & Mingle Christmas Market on 29th Nov we are holding a St Vincent de Paul Food Drive to support families in our local community. We would be grateful for any donations, big or small. Donations can be dropped from 12–4pm on Sunday Nov 29th.
